div.style: box-sizing: border-box; display: grid; grid-template-rows: [label] minmax(2.5em, max-content) [value] 1fr; height: 100%; padding: 20px

span.style: -webkit-box-orient: vertical; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; color: #6b7280; display: -webkit-box; font-size: 14px; grid-row: label; overflow: hidden; text-align: center
align-self: center; color: #374151; font-size: 36px; font-weight: bold; grid-row: value; text-align: center
